newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian GPG sees 96 net profit soaring.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian GPG sees 96 net profit soaring.

text.p: Slovenian construction company Gradbeno Podjetje Grosuplje d.d. (GPG) said on Tuesday 1996 net profit is expected to jump to 90 million tolars ($0.6 million) from 11.3 million in 1995.
The company said the huge jump was due to a dramatic recovery in business last year following a horrific 1995, when net profit slumped heavily.
Sales are expected to have risen to 7.46 billion tolars from 5.9 billion in 1995.
The company said it had not yet decided whether it would pay a dividend on ordinary shares that are listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse.
Last year, GPG paid no dividend on ordinary shares, while preferred shares, which are not listed, have a fixed four percent dividend on their nominal value of 10,000 tolars.
